meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Create and edit formatted Word documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently produce or modify Word documents with complex formatting.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能创建、读取、编辑 .docx/.dotx 文件，处理目录、标题、页码等格式；也能提取内容、插入图片、查找替换、处理修订和评论。
howto.when: 当你说出“Word 文档”“.docx”“.dotx”等词，或要求创建、编辑 Word 文件、处理文档内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这份 .docx 转成带目录的正式报告。
say.note: 会生成新 Word 文件并自动排版。

say.text: 在这个文档的第三页插入一张图片。
say.note: 需提供图片路径或文件名。

say.text: 把这个 Word 文件中的“旧公司”全部替换成“新公司”。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can create, read, and edit .docx/.dotx files, handle formatting like TOCs, headings, page numbers; also extract content, insert images, find-and-replace, and manage tracked changes and comments.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'Word doc', '.docx', '.dotx', or ask to create, edit Word files, or process document content.

say_en.text: Convert this .docx into a formal report with a table of contents.
say_en.note: A new Word file with auto layout is generated.

say_en.text: Insert an image on page three of this document.
say_en.note: Provide the image path or filename.

say_en.text: Replace all 'Old Company' with 'New Company' in this Word file.
